basic_profile.bio: I'm a music enthusiast and a self-taught clarinet player from Austin, Texas. I recently got into PC gaming and building custom PCs. I work as a freelance music teacher and spend my free evenings exploring new games and learning about PC hardware. Usually online in the late evenings. Single, and enjoying the freedom it brings to pursue my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of self-teaching and community learning. I have a strong background in music theory and clarinet performance, which I've honed over years of practice and teaching. My interest in technology and gaming is relatively new, fueled by online tutorials and forums like Reddit.
